title: 2022 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 Heritage Edition

sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2022 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 Heritage Edition, finished in Brittany Blue with an Ebony interior, and will be displayed live at Willow Springs Reimagined as part of the Cars & Bids Willow Springs Collection. The odometer on this Mustang currently displays 12 miles. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, this Mustang cost $114,455 new. A partial list of notable factory equipment includes the Carbon Fiber Track, Technology, and GT500 Heritage packages, 20-inch exposed carbon fiber wheels, a Torsen differential with a 3.73 axle ratio, a GT500-specific body kit, Recaro leather-trimmed front seats, and a Bang & Olufsen sound system. The seller reports no notable modifications. This Mustang is offered with a clean Carfax vehicle history report and has reportedly been registered to one owner since new. Ford enlisted the help of Shelby to bring the GT500 back for the 2020 model year. No longer battling among mere muscle cars, the range-topping version of the last-generation Mustang brought the fight to legitimate supercars; it notably posted a faster lap time around the Virginia International Raceway than the Lamborghini Huracán Evo during Car and Driver's 2021 Lightning Lap competition. Power comes from a hand-built 5.2-liter supercharged V8, rated at 760 horsepower and 625 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission.
